transcript: Welcome to the garden lab, Ava! Let's discover how plants and animals work together. Ava watches a fuzzy bee land on a bright sunflower. As the bee sips nectar, yellow pollen sticks to its legs. When it flies to the next flower, it helps the plant make new seeds! Look at that squirrel! It hides a crunchy acorn in the soft soil. Sometimes squirrels forget where they hide them, and those seeds grow into tall oak trees. Animals help spread seeds far and wide. Now it is your turn to help the garden grow! Match the helpers to their jobs.
